title: Master Purchase Agreement

issues.quote: Seller will ship each order no later than 10 days after receiving Buyer's purchase order.
issues.why: "will" used to impose a duty on a party.

issues.quote: Buyer may reject nonconforming Products within 10 days of delivery.
issues.why: "within 10 days of" can mean before or after.
issues.fix: no later than 10 days after delivery

issues.quote: Seller shall replace any rejected products at Seller's expense no later than 15 days after Buyer rejects them.
issues.why: Lowercase use of the defined term "Products".

issues.anchor: arising out of or relating to
issues.quote: Seller shall indemnify Buyer against third-party claims arising out of or relating to defects in the Products.
issues.fix: arising out of defects in the Products

issues.quote: It is expressly understood that Seller is not Buyer's exclusive supplier.
issues.fix: Seller is not Buyer's exclusive supplier.

issues.why: A form of certificate is a stand-alone document, so it belongs in an exhibit, not a schedule.
issues.fix: Make it Exhibit 2 (Form of Quality Certificate), after Exhibit 1.

issues.quote: Price shall be adjusted annually under Section 4.3
issues.why: Table cell: passive hides who adjusts the price (and how); also "shall" with no duty.
issues.fix: Seller may adjust this price once each year by notice to Buyer, by no more than [x]%.

issues.quote: Price shall be adjusted annually under Section 4.3
issues.why: Table cell: numbered cross-reference, and it points to nothing (the agreement has no Section 4.3).
issues.fix: Refer by heading to a real provision, or state the adjustment rule in the cell.

issues.quote: Payment due net 30 days after invoice date
issues.why: Table cell: payment due 30 days after the invoice date conflicts with B.2 ("no later than 45 days after receiving it").
issues.fix: Reconcile: delete the cell term or conform it to B.2.

issues.quote: Volume discount of 5% on orders of ten (10) boxes or more

traps.quote: Seller represents and warrants that the Products will be free from defects in materials and workmanship for 12 months after delivery.
traps.why_correct: Other side's draft: house rule 10 says keep "represents and warrants". A comment suggesting the remedies-neutral "states" is fine; flagging it as an error or rewriting it is a false positive.

traps.quote: Seller is not required to accept any purchase order for more than 2,000 cases in any calendar month.

traps.anchor: Section 355.2-207 of the Kentucky Revised Statutes
traps.quote: If a purchase order conflicts with this Agreement, this Agreement controls, despite Section 355.2-207 of the Kentucky Revised Statutes.
Buyer shall order Products by submitting a purchase order in the form of Exhibit 1.
traps.why_correct: Correct label and classification: a form of purchase order is an exhibit, numbered.

notes: Other side's draft. 4 issues are inside the Schedule A table cells (passive-voice, cross-reference-number, conflict, number-words). Item numbers 0410, 0415, 0522, 0530 are zero-padded text and correct. Schedule A is correctly a schedule; Schedule B (a form) is the misclassified attachment. Party names have no article.
